prefix.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shroud. Spirit.</c> Create a powerful blast that damages enemies in the area, then summon a Spirit of Wanderlust at that location. Wanderlust knocks down enemies and creates a lingering area that deals damage and inflicts conditions.

facts.description: Incoming condition damage decreased by 33%; stacks duration.

prefix.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shroud. Spirit.</c> Grant boons to nearby allies, then summon a spirit of preservation. Preservation will unleash a burst of energy, healing and removing conditions from nearby allies.

facts.description: Skills and actions are faster.
Endurance regeneration increased by 50%; stacks duration.

traits.name: Spirit's Strength
traits.description: Your summoned creatures deal more damage and their healing is increased. Spirits and minions are creatures.

traits.name: Charged Souls
traits.description: Gain access to spirit innervation skills, allowing you to channel energy to your spirits for an additional effect. Gain life force when you use an innervate skill.

traits.name: Wielder's Boon
traits.description: Weapon spells remove conditions from affected allies. Affected allies receive the full benefit of weapon spells.

traits.name: Lingering Spirits
traits.description: Gain a bonus for each active spirit. Spirits persist when exiting ritualist's shroud but continue to drain life force. Life force that is gained during this time will not be consumed by spirits.

facts.description: You deal increased strike damage.
Your movement speed is increased.
Your outgoing healing is increased.

traits.name: Soul Twisting
traits.description: The first spirit skill you use when entering ritualist's shroud recharges instantly.

uniqueSkills.name: Innervate Anguish
uniqueSkills.description: Channel power to your Spirit of Anguish, damaging nearby enemies and granting might to nearby allies.

uniqueSkills.name: Innervate Wanderlust
uniqueSkills.description: Channel power to your Spirit of Wanderlust, inflicting fear on nearby enemies.

facts.description: Involuntary retreat; unable to act; stacks duration.
Involuntary retreat; unable to act; stacks duration.

uniqueSkills.name: Innervate Preservation
uniqueSkills.description: Channel power to your Spirit of Preservation, granting defensive boons to nearby allies.

uniqueSkills.name: Ritualist's Shroud
uniqueSkills.description: Assume the form of a ritualist and gain new skills, turning your life force into health.

uniqueSkills.name: Essence Blast
uniqueSkills.description: Shroud. Fire a blast of energy that is more powerful for each active spirit. Active spirits will prioritize attacking the last enemy targeted by this skill if they are in range.

uniqueSkills.name: Anguish
uniqueSkills.description: Shroud. Spirit. Mark an enemy to take more damage from your summoned creatures, then summon a spirit of anguish. Anguish fires a barrage of projectiles that deal increased damage against crowd-controlled enemies and for each condition on those enemies.

uniqueSkills.name: Wanderlust
uniqueSkills.description: Shroud. Spirit. Create a powerful blast that damages enemies in the area, then summon a Spirit of Wanderlust at that location. Wanderlust knocks down enemies and creates a lingering area that deals damage and inflicts conditions.

uniqueSkills.name: Preservation
uniqueSkills.description: Shroud. Spirit. Grant boons to nearby allies, then summon a spirit of preservation. Preservation will unleash a burst of energy, healing and removing conditions from nearby allies.

uniqueSkills.name: Summon Spirits
uniqueSkills.description: Shroud. You and any active spirits shadowstep to the target area. Any spirits that aren't currently using their initial skill will immediately use an additional skill.
